# now

<link-summary>Returns the current time in milliseconds since the epoch.</link-summary>

<web-summary>now() — Returns the current time in milliseconds since the epoch. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>time</code> · Since: 1.5.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function now(): number;
```

A named function instead of `Date.now()` scattered through the code, so that measuring time is one thing a test can replace.

## Returns

`number` — the current timestamp in milliseconds.

## Examples

### Measuring elapsed time

```javascript
const started = now();

// … work …

const elapsed = now() - started; // milliseconds
```
